The scale midpoint (50) is the middle of the scale, not an average over others. The overall figure is the average of your dimension percentages (equal weights). 0 % Percent of scale range 0 100 ADHD 0 % Autism 0 % 50 = the scale midpoint (not an average) Percent of scale range note.trait.not-normed Score is percent of scale range, not percentiles — no norms are applied. Based on self-report — the instrument in this implementation is not psychometrically validated. No norms were applied: scores are not percentiles. A result here is never a referral — it gives no recommendation for further assessment and does not replace healthcare professionals. Shared results are generic: they carry no personal data and are not documentation or an assessment of a person. How to read this Each bar runs from 0 to 100 and shows how much of that dimension's scale range your answers cover. The midpoint line (50) is only the middle of the scale. Above or below the midpoint does not mean 'good' or 'bad' — only that your answers sit on one or the other side of the scale's middle. The tests here come in two types: self-report (personality, relations, triage) and tasks with correct answers (ability). Self-reported scores say nothing about what you can or cannot do — they are not percentiles and not a measure of intelligence. Ability results are raw counts and estimates with an uncertainty interval — they are not percentiles either, and they reflect this test's limited set of tasks, not an overall assessment of intelligence. Mood and state can affect how you answer a test — how you feel while taking it can move your scores up or down. Treat the result as a snapshot, not a fixed trait. This report is written so that you (and anyone you share it with) can understand the result without having seen the tests. All limitations are stated here in plain text. If you did not take the test This report is based on a person's own answers in a web test. The tests come in two types: self-report (personality, relations, triage: the person's own view of themselves — may be coloured by mood and situation) and tasks with correct answers (ability — raw counts and estimates with uncertainty). Scores are not normed: they are not percentiles, not compared with others, and the 'midpoint' of a chart is the middle of the scale (50), not a group average. The result is not medically, psychologically or clinically assessed and cannot be used for hiring or other important decisions. [standard] nd-triage-pool How you feel when you take the test (mood, stress, sleep) can affect the answers — the result is a snapshot of a state, not a constant. Brainarea is an indicative self-insight tool for general interest — not medical or psychological assessment, and not suitable as the sole basis for hiring or other important decisions.

How to read this — in a conversation The chart shows the test-taker's scores per dimension as percent of the scale range (0–100): for self-report tests it is the test-taker's own reporting; for ability tests it is the share of tasks answered correctly. In both cases: ask about the context rather than the number. Your personal picture Same score computation as the standard frame: percent of scale range, not normed. The overall figure is the average of your dimension percentages (equal weights). The personal part is the reading of what scores may say about you — with all standard-frame caveats intact. 0 % Percent of scale range 0 100 ADHD 0 % Autism 0 % 50 = the scale midpoint (not an average) Percent of scale range note.trait.not-normed Score is percent of scale range, not percentiles — no norms are applied. Based on self-report — the instrument in this implementation is not psychometrically validated. No norms were applied: scores are not percentiles. A result here is never a referral — it gives no recommendation for further assessment and does not replace healthcare professionals. Shared results are generic: they carry no personal data and are not documentation or an assessment of a person. How to read this — personally This frame reads the scores in the first person and points at what they MAY mean for you — it never claims what you ARE. A score is a tendency in your own answers, not a truth about you. Self-report measures how you perceive yourself here and now, and self-perception changes — with mood, situation and experience; retesting later may give a different picture, and that is built into the tool, not a defect. Ability tests instead measure task performance: answers are right or wrong, and the result is given as a raw count and an estimate with an uncertainty interval — retaking can also give a somewhat different figure. The midpoint line (50) is the scale's midpoint, not an average — read the standard frame's guide to the chart. If you did not take the test This is one person's own answers in a web test, at one point in time. For self-report tests (personality, relations, triage) the answers are the person's own description of themselves — not an objective measurement. For ability tests the result is a raw count and estimates from the tasks in this particular test. Neither is normed or compared with others. [personal] nd-triage-pool Mood, stress and sleep when taking the test can colour the answers. Treat the text as a snapshot — feel free to retest, but do not expect an identical result. Brainarea is an indicative self-insight tool for general interest — not medical or psychological assessment, and not suitable as the sole basis for hiring or other important decisions.

Din profil Skårene angir prosent av skalaens omfang (0–100) — de er ikke persentiler, ikke normert mot en befolkningsgruppe og ikke diagnostiske. Midtpunktet på skalaen (50) er skalaens midt, ikke et gjennomsnitt over andre. Samletallet er gjennomsnittet av dimensjonsprosentene dine (like vekter). 0 % Prosent av skalaens omfang 0 100 ADHD 0 % Autisme 0 % 50 = skalaens midtpunkt (ikke et gjennomsnitt) Prosent av skalaens omfang note.trait.not-normed Skår er prosent av skala-omfang, ikke persentiler — ingen normer er brukt. Basert på selvrapportering — instrumentet er ikke psykometrisk validert i denne implementasjonen. Ingen normer ble brukt: skårene er ikke persentiler. Et resultat her er aldri en henvisning — det gir ingen anbefaling om utredning og erstatter ikke helsepersonell. Resultater som deles er generiske: de bærer ingen persondata og er ikke dokumentasjon eller vurdering av en person. Slik leser du dette Hver bar går fra 0 til 100 og viser hvor stor andel av skalaens omfang svarene dine ligger på for den dimensjonen. Midtpunktstreken (50) er bare midten av skalaen. En score over eller under midten betyr ikke «bra» eller «dårlig» — det betyr bare at svarene dine ligger på den ene eller andre siden av skalaens midtpunkt. Testene her er av to typer: selvrapportering (personlighet, relasjoner, triage) og oppgavetester med riktige svar (evner). Selvrapporterte skår sier ingenting om hva du kan eller ikke kan gjøre — de er ikke persentiler og ikke et intelligensmål. Evneresultater er råtrekk og estimater med usikkerhetsintervall — heller ikke de er persentiler, og de gjenspeiler testens begrensede oppgavesett, ikke en helhetsvurdering av intelligens. Humør og tilstand kan påvirke svarene dine i en test — humøret når du tar den kan flytte skårene opp eller ned. Ta resultatet som et øyeblikksbilde, ikke en fastsatt egenskap. Denne rapporten er laget for at du (og eventuelt noen du deler den med) skal forstå resultatet uten å ha sett testene. Alle begrensninger står her i teksten. For deg som ikke tok testen Denne rapporten er basert på en persons egne svar i en nettbasert test. Tester her er av to typer: selvrapportering (personlighet, relasjoner, triage: personens oppfatning av seg selv — kan farges av humør og situasjon) og oppgavetester med riktige svar (evner — råtrekk og estimater med usikkerhet). Skårene er ikke normert: de er ikke persentiler, ikke sammenlignet med andre, og «midtpunktet» i en graf er skalaens midte (50), ikke et gruppegjennomsnitt. Resultatet er ikke medisinsk, psykologisk eller klinisk vurdert og kan ikke brukes til ansettelse eller andre viktige beslutninger. [standard] nd-triage-pool Hvordan du har det når du tar testen (humør, stress, søvn) kan påvirke svarene — resultatet er et øyeblikksbilde av en tilstand, ikke en konstant. Brainarea er et indikativt selvinnsikt-verktøy for alminnelig interesse — ikke medisinsk eller psykologisk vurdering, og ikke egnet som eneste grunnlag for ansettelse eller andre viktige beslutninger.
